# Pirate Arcade

Pirate Arcade is a public game and build-log project by Erich Donahue. It combines a four-game Python/Pygame desktop arcade collection with browser ports, an Astro static website, GitHub releases, and Cloudflare Pages hosting.

## Project summary

The project asks how much of a complete, inspectable, public software project one person can ship using local hardware, free-to-use AI coding tools, open source software, GitHub, and Cloudflare's free tier. It is not a commercial game studio or subscription product.

## Games

- Cannonball Clash: a naval Pong riff with power-ups, procedural audio, AI opponent support, and browser play at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/cannonball-clash/.
- Treasure Cove: a treasure-hunt brick breaker with score combos, paddle power-up, procedural audio, and browser play at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/treasure-cove/.
- Kraken's Wake: an Asteroids-style sea-monster survival game, playable in browser at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/krakens-wake/.
- Port Royale Tycoon: a pirate property-trading board game in the desktop release.

## Technology

- Desktop games: Python, Pygame, NumPy, procedural audio.
- Browser ports: Pygbag, WebAssembly, Web Audio API bridge.
- Website: Astro, TypeScript, vanilla CSS, Cloudflare Pages.
- Distribution: GitHub repositories, CI, and releases.
- Development constraint: local X600 workstation, free-to-use AI models, no paid AI subscriptions, no cloud compute.
